description: Post-only paired maker with a pairing LOOP (issue #872): when the sum of the two RESTABLE post-only quotes is under max_pair_cost, buy BOTH legs with EQUAL declared share counts, each quote strictly UNDER its own ask (the kernel refuses an at-ask post-only POST, #464 — there is no at-ask mode). The pair is NOT a single frozen batch: a fresh attempt emits both legs instantly, then every later cycle re-quotes BOTH legs under the per-leg requote_sec throttle (default 15 s — the ticket's 10-20 s rhythm), so a moved book gets a moved quote. Maker fee = 0 is the premise (the manifest declares entry_maker — #742 post-only, never escalates; bk.fees() is touched ONLY for the naked-remainder's fallback cost). INVENTORY CAP: held shares (bk.holdings() — this strategy's positions) count against max_shares_per_leg; the pair declares the SMALLER leg's head-room; at cap the condition is done — no further sizing, the ticket's hard single-side ceiling. NAKED REMAINDER: the completion leg is qualified every cycle by the top-up rule (incremental all-in = ask + the fallback taker fee vs max_top_up_cost), sized to the exact shortfall, and throttled like any leg — #848 hold-to-settlement release is its re-entry; a gap past the ceiling is dead and the held leg rides to settlement. NEAR-EXPIRY PULL: at time_left <= pull_before_sec the condition's lingering bids are pulled via the kernel's breaks channel (#904's cancel vocabulary), once per round, and nothing re-quotes after. MERGE: a complete pair in hand emits reason=merge for BOTH legs every cycle (the kernel burns stacked pairs at $1/pair, fee-free). ZERO kernel changes; same surfaces as maker_pair (#871): entry_maker, atomic_batch (NO pot ships — the allowlist stays empty until replay + soak say GO), holds_to_settlement, breaks; trailing_exit NOT declared (the three-state default, #742). The conservative replay stance: only trade-through maker fills count, no rebate inside the strategy's own math. Signal-only: the kernel adjudicates, sizes and gates every intent.
